surface_mechanism_description: Growth mechanism involves in-situ copper reduction and loss of sulfur by evaporation
evidence: Depending on the number of ALD cycles, multiphase compounds (made of digenite Cu1.8S, chalcocite Cu 2S, djurleite Cu31S16 and covellite CuS) or single-phase digenite Cu1.8S films are obtained via a growth mechanism that involves in-situ copper reduction and loss of sulfur by evaporation.
